reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same function the app uses for what a schedule posts.

duplication.why: No rule logic is restated; the API model just delegates.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API's schedule mapping layer, with the rule left in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Touches only the API model, its result type, the handler type, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A separate result type keeps the read-only field out of create/update inputs, and future rule changes reach the API automatically.
